Name: Kenneth's Vanilla Seeds Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b]Kenneth's Vanilla Seeds Addon[/b]

[b]Never miss a planting season again! Get ALL seeds, saplings, and tree seeds year-round![/b]

[b]What it does:[/b]
[b]🌱 52 Vanilla Seeds & Saplings added to Kenneth's Seed Shop (Shop 3) - all seasons available, all year![/b]

[b]Includes:[/b]

[b]🌾 Crop Seeds (Spring to Fall):[/b]
[b]Parsnip, Green Bean, Cauliflower, Potato, Tulip, Kale, Garlic, Rice Shoot, Melon, Tomato, Blueberry, Hot Pepper, Wheat, Radish, Red Cabbage, Starfruit, Corn, Eggplant, Pumpkin, Bok Choy, Yam, Beet, Rhubarb, Pineapple, Ancient Seeds, Strawberry, Coffee Bean, Poppy, Summer Spangle, Sunflower, Spice Berry, Amaranth, Cranberry, Taro Tuber, Cactus, Qi Bean & more![/b]

[b]🌸 Flower Seeds:[/b]
[b]Jazz, Tulip Bulb, Poppy, Fairy Seeds, Sunflower, Summer Spangle[/b]

[b]🌳 Fruit Tree Saplings:[/b]
[b]Cherry, Apricot, Orange, Peach, Apple, Pomegranate, Banana (25,000g), Mango (25,000g), Tea Sapling[/b]

[b]🌲 Wild Tree Seeds:[/b]
[b]Acorn, Maple Seed, Pine Cone, Mahogany Seed, Mushroom Tree Seed (25,000g), Mystic Tree Seed[/b]

[b]🌿 Grass Starters:[/b]
[b]Grass Starter & Blue Grass Starter (10,000g)[/b]

[b]💰 Balanced Price. Slightly more than Pierre's but available all year round - no more waiting for the right season![/b]

[b]Perfect for:[/b]
[b]• Planting any crop any season - no more seasonal limits[/b]
[b]• Completing your farm layout quickly[/b]
[b]• Getting rare saplings (Banana, Mango, Mushroom Tree) without waiting for Island Trader[/b]
[b]• New players who want year-round farming freedom[/b]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[b]• Kenneth's Seed Shop (Required)[/b]
[b]• Content Patcher[/b]
[b]• Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ [/b]

[b]Lightweight & Balanced - no new items, just vanilla seeds & saplings in your favorite shop![/b]

Manifest.Name: Kenneth's Vanilla Seeds Addon
Manifest.Description: Adds vanilla seeds, saplings and tree seeds to Kenneth's Seed Shop - Shop 3. Requires Kenneth's Seed Shop. Separate balanced lightweight addon mod.
Manifest.Author: KennethFiel
